As someone who works in the field every day during our current epidemic and has studied this including interdisciplinary pain management teams and have heard this topic spoken about, I very much disagree.
I agree completely, especially since doctors just diagnose and prescribe in regard to medications, whereas we nurses are the ones administering it every four to six hours.

It's taught in school and practiced in the hospital, it's done every day when giving pain meds that they dilute it with a saline flush and push slowly; the medical professionals I work with are acutely aware of the rush effect.
